name: Castalla (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist, white above and light blue below, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Castalla (a castle within a wreath beneath a crown).
history: Municipal flag of Castalla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Castalla arms — castle within a wreath
